description: Forza Horizon 6 launch is upon us. Ahead of release, Playground Games has revealed global release timings for the game. Forza Horizon 6 reviews are out, too. The open world racing title is now the highest-rated game of the year so far. Forza Horizon 6 is available on Xbox Series S/X, PC, and Game Pass.
title: Forza Horizon 6 Launch: Release Timings, Price, Ratings and Everything You Need to Know

description: New models suggest Uranus and Neptune may contain significantly more rock than ice beneath their atmospheres. The findings challenge decades of planetary science and could lead to a reclassification of the outer planets.
title: New Study Suggests Uranus and Neptune May Contain More Rock Than Ice

description: Moto G37 Power and Moto G37 are confirmed to launch in India next week. They will be available for purchase through Flipkart in the country. The India variant of the handsets is confirmed to come with the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset. The Moto G37 Power will have a 7,000mAh battery. They were launched in European markets in April.
title: Moto G37 Power, Moto G37 India Launch Date Announced, Key Features Revealed

description: Apple is reportedly developing a more advanced OLED display for a 2028 iPhone that could reduce distortion and brightness loss around curved edges. The company is said to be considering Indium Zinc Oxide cathodes for this purpose. The technology is expected to build on the four-sided bending display rumoured for the 20th-anniversary iPhone in 2027. Samsung Display and LG Display are reportedly preparing their production lines, with LG already investing 1.106 trillion won in new OLED infrastructure.
title: Apple in Talks to Upgrade 2028 iPhone With More Advanced Quad-Curved OLED Display: Report

description: The ongoing Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026 brings attractive discounts on the latest washing machines, making it a great time to buy. Different models from top brands like LG, Samsung, and IFB are listed with slashed rates in the ongoing sale. Interested users can avail of coupon discounts and bank discounts.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Top Deals on 5-Star Rated Washing Machines

description: With the ongoing memory shortage, solid-state drives (SSDs) have witnessed a meteoric price hike. Even 256GB and 512GB drives now cost 2-3X of what they did just a year ago. However, if you do not want to break the bank just to buy an external hard disk, the Amazon Great Summer Sale is the right place.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Best Deals on SSD

description: Fenwick & West LLP is facing a $525 million lawsuit filed by a group of FTX victims who allege the firm helped conceal fraud tied to the collapsed crypto exchange. The complaint cites shell companies, internal messaging systems, and testimony from former FTX executives.
title: Law Firm Fenwick & West Sued Over Alleged Role in FTX Collapse

description: Dell has expanded its laptop portfolio with a new gaming model and two AI-focused mainstream models. The Alienware 15 combines a high-refresh-rate display with Nvidia RTX graphics and user-upgradeable memory and storage. Meanwhile, the Dell 14S and Dell 16S bring Copilot+ features, optional OLED screens, and slim aluminium designs. Dell says the new consumer laptops are designed to handle gaming, content creation, and everyday productivity while offering longer battery life and improved portability.
title: Dell Refreshes Alienware 15 Laptop With Up to GeForce RTX 5060 GPU; New Dell 14S and Dell 16S Models Announced

description: Amazon, on Wednesday, announced Alexa for Shopping, a new artificial intelligence (AI) shopping assistant. The new tool comes with agentic capabilities and replaces Rufus AI, a mainstay on the app and the website since February 2024. The Seattle-based tech giant revealed that the new AI experience combines Rufus AI and Alexa+ to bring an assistant that not only has deep knowledge of Amazon’s shopping platform and catalogued products, but also brings the immersive conversational layer with agentic automation.
title: Amazon Kills Rufus AI, Replaces It With Alexa for Shopping AI Assistant

description: A new leak has reignited fans' hopes for a third GTA 6 trailer. Some users have reported receiving an email from Best Buy that says GTA 6 pre-orders will go live on May 18. If the information is true, Rockstar could release a new GTA 6 trailer, along with pricing and pre-order information, next week.
title: New Leak Suggests GTA 6 Pre-Orders Could Begin on May 18, Third Trailer Coming Next Week

title: OTT Releases This Week (May 11 - May 17): Dhurandhar 2, Inspector Avinash S2, Kartavya, Project Hail Mary, and More

description: Amazon Great Summer Sale is letting you save up to Rs. 11,000 on your next dashcam. The ongoing sale event, which began last week, is offering dashcams from brands like Qubo, 70mai, CP Plus, Blaupunkt, and RedTiger at discounted prices. Along with direct price cuts, the company is providing a 10 percent instant discount of up to Rs. 9,500 with an HDFC Bank credit card. You can also get additional cashback on your purchase if you have an Amazon Prime membership.
title: Amazon Great Summer Sale: Best Deals on Car Dashcams From Qubo, 70mai and More

description: HMD Vibe 2 5G will be powered by a Unisoc T8200 chipset, a tipster claims. The leaker has shared the price, RAM and storage configurations, and other key features of the upcoming smartphone. The handset will reportedly sport a 6.75-inch HD+ LCD touchscreen, delivering up to 120Hz of refresh rate. Moreover, it is expected to be equipped with an 8-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls. The handset could ship with an IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance. This comes shortly after the company announced that the handset will be launched in India on May 21.
title: HMD Vibe 2 5G Price in India and Key Specifications Surface Online a Week Ahead of Launch

description: The Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300 FE are now available for purchase in India. The handsets were launched in the country on May 6, following their China debut earlier this year. The Vivo X300 Ultra arrives as the top-of-the-line model in the flagship lineup, equipped with triple Zeiss master prime lenses and Snapdragon 8 Gen Elite 5 SoC. The X300 FE, meanwhile, gets the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip under the hood. Both phones run on Android 16-based OriginOS 6.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300 FE Go in Sale in India With Zeiss-Tuned Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Crypto exchange Paybis has secured MiCA and PSD2 licences through its EU entity, SIA Paybis Europe. The approvals allow the company to provide regulated crypto asset and payment services across the European Union and broader EEA region.
title: Paybis Secures MiCA and PSD2 Licences Ahead of EU Crypto Expansion

description: Google has showcased a new way for users to verify the authenticity of the OS their Android smartphone is running. The Mountain View-based tech giant showcased the new Android OS Verification tool recently during The Android Show: I/O Edition, which was held as part of the company’s upcoming Google I/O developer conference. The company said that the new OS verification tool will arrive with the Android 17 update, which is expected to be rolled out to select Google Pixel phones soon. Google claims that the feature will help in curbing the distribution of unofficial and modified versions of Android.
title: Android 17 to Introduce New OS Verification Tool to Curb Distribution of Unofficial Versions

description: Xiaomi 17 Max is teased to come with a first Leica-tuned 200-megapixel primary rear camera with a 1/1.4-inch sensor. It will run on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. It will have an 8,000mAh battery, marking an upgrade over other Xiaomi 17 series phones. It is teased to have a 6.9-inch display and will be offered in Sky Blue, White, and Pixel Black colour options. The company is also accepting pre-reservations for the phone in China.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Key Specifications Confirmed; Will Feature Biggest Battery in the Lineup

description: Realme has revealed several features of the Buds Air 8 Pro and Watch S5 ahead of their India debut on May 22. The earbuds will support 55dB active noise cancellation, LHDC audio, and up to 50 hours of battery life with the case. The smartwatch will offer a 1.43-inch AMOLED display, built-in GPS, and up to 20 days of battery life. Both products will launch alongside the Realme 16T 5G smartphone in India.
title: Realme Buds Air 8 Pro, Realme Watch S5 to Launch in India Alongside Realme 16T 5G; Key Features Revealed

description: Mr X is a Tamil sci-fi action thriller starring Arya, where a betrayed intelligence officer gains invisibility powers after a chemical incident and turns into a vigilante seeking revenge while protecting the nation, blending action, emotion, and suspense as it streams on JioHotstar from May 14, 2026.
title: Mr X Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About This New Arya’s Invisible Spy Thriller Online?

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 will reportedly be the first in the Galaxy lineup to support Google’s newly announced Gemini Intelligence platform. The Gemini Intelligence, a suite of advanced AI features designed for Android smartphones, was previewed at The Android Show I/O Edition earlier this week. It is confirmed to make its way to the Galaxy S26 series and the upcoming Google Pixel 10 lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Flip 8 to Launch With Google’s Gemini Intelligence Features: Report

description: Microsoft announced new features for the mobile version of Edge on Wednesday. The company said that it is bringing agentic capabilities with Copilot in Edge on phones for the first time. With Copilot in Edge, users will be able to ask queries on their handsets without leaving the browser, and Microsoft’s AI assistant will be able to generate answers by retrieving context and information from various open tabs. Microsoft has also introduced new productivity tools for the desktop version of Edge.
title: Microsoft Edge Update Allows Copilot to Access Open Tabs; Journeys Mode Introduced in English

description: Anthropic, on Wednesday, announced a new offering for smaller enterprises. Dubbed Claude for Small Business, the new solution brings a set of new connectors and ready-to-run workflows to power artificial intelligence (AI)-powered automation within tools that small businesses use the most. With this release, the San Francisco-based AI startup is also diversifying its product and service offerings to serve different enterprise niches.
title: Anthropic Introduces Claude for Small Business With Ready-to-Run AI Workflows, Connectors

description: Avatar: Fire and Ash is finally releasing on JioHotstar on June 24th, 2026. This time, the conflicts will escalate in Pandora as the new force intensifies the situation.
title: Avatar: Fire and Ash OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch James Cameron's Sci-Fi Movie Online?

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will be launched in India soon, the Xiaomi sub-brand announced on Thursday. The handset is set to arrive months after its arrival in China, along with the Redmi Turbo 5 Max. As part of the announcement, the tech firm has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone. The handset appears in a black colourway, which retails in China as the Shadow Black (translated from Chinese). It is shown to feature a dual rear camera system, with two individually placed lenses placed in the top-left corner of the panel.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Launch Teased Along With Design, Will Be First Redmi Turbo Handset to Debut in India

description: Bitcoin traded near $79,800 on Thursday as stronger-than-expected US inflation data and ETF outflows weighed on sentiment in the crypto market. Analysts said traders remain cautious as Bitcoin struggles near key resistance levels while macroeconomic uncertainty continues to pressure risk assets.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $80,000 as Inflation Data Weighs on Crypto Market Sentiment

title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Lineup for May Revealed: Star Wars Outlaws, The Thaumaturge and More

description: Canon on Wednesday expanded its mirrorless camera portfolio in India with the launch of the new EOS R6 V full-frame video camera, alongside the RF20-50mm f/4L IS USM PZ lens. The company claims that the new RF20-50mm lens is Canon’s first professional-grade full-frame L-series lens with a built-in power zoom system.
title: Canon EOS R6 V Full-Frame Video Camera Launched in India With F20-50mm Power Zoom Lens: Price, Specifications

As Vergil returns with dangerous ambitions, Dante faces emotional and physical battles. The season also introduces Nero and explores the legacy of Sparda, raising the stakes significantly.
title: Devil May Cry Season 2 Now Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch it Online?

description: A tipster has suggested the launch timeline of the Vivo T5 Lite and Realme P4R. The Vivo T5 Lite is expected to run on a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 or Dimensity 6400 chipset. The Realme P4R is said to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 SoC.

title: iQOO Z11 India Launch Timeline, Price Leaked; Could Arrive With Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC

description: Vivo X500 will sport a 6.59-inch display, according to a tipster's post on Weibo. Meanwhile, the rumoured Vivo X500 Pro model will reportedly boast a more compact 6.31-inch touchscreen. Lastly, the rumoured Vivo X500 Pro Max might ship with a large 6.85-inch screen. This suggests that the standard Vivo X500 will sport a notably larger display than its predecessor, as the Vivo X300 features a 6.31-inch 1.5K AMOLED screen. On the other hand, the Vivo X500 Pro might boast a more compact size compared to its predecessor, which is equipped with a 6.78-inch AMOLED screen.

description: Huawei has launched the MatePad Pro Max globally with a 13.2-inch flexible OLED PaperMatte display, 144Hz refresh rate, and 1,600 nits peak brightness. The tablet measures 4.7mm thick and weighs as little as 499g. It packs a 10,400mAh battery with 66W fast charging, a 50-megapixel rear camera, and HarmonyOS 4.3. The device supports the Huawei Glide Keyboard and M-Pencil Pro. Pricing starts at EUR 1,399 (roughly Rs. 1,57,100) for the base PaperMatte model.
title: Huawei MatePad Pro Max Launched Globally With 4.7mm Slim Profile, 13.2-Inch Display and 10,400mAh Battery

description: Samsung is said to be developing a new productivity-focused feature to reduce distractions by controlling internet access at the network level. The feature, reportedly discovered within One UI 9, can selectively block internet connectivity for specific categories of apps such as social media, games, and streaming platforms. As per the report, the functionality is still experimental and was sighted after Samsung commenced the rollout of Android 17-based One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S26 series.
title: Samsung Developing One UI 9 Feature That Blocks Distracting Apps at Network Level: Report

description: Meta on Wednesday announced the launch of Instants. It is a new Instagram feature designed to make casual photo sharing between friends faster and more spontaneous. The company claims it allows users to share unfiltered, ephemeral photos directly through Instagram’s inbox. Alongside the feature, Meta is experimenting with a standalone Instants app in select countries to provide quicker camera access. It is said to have a similar functionality as Snapchat, while retaining Instagram’s existing safety, privacy, and parental supervision features for teens.
title: Instagram Launches Instants Feature for Ephemeral Content Sharing; Standalone App Announced
